title: Session Marker v1.0
description: Shape of {workspace_root}/shared/sessions/{session_id}.json — the AMO per-session binding marker that pins ONE Claude session (keyed by its session UUID) to ONE SEO project slug, so a user can run 3-5 projects in parallel (one per session) without cross-contamination. Written by /pseo-bind keyed by $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (command context); read by a SessionStart hook keyed by the stdin session_id (hook context) in AMO batch 0c — the two ids are the SAME UUID for a session (batch 0a probe). Resolution falls back to shared/active.json when a session is unbound. Lives workspace-GLOBAL under shared/ alongside active.json, NOT per-project _state/.

schema_version.description: Marker schema version (ADR-018 const discipline). Optional — the ephemeral per-session marker is rewritten on every /pseo-bind, so it is not in required[]; declared here so a future bump can discriminate older markers.

active_project.description: Project slug this session is bound to (matches projects/<slug>/project.config.json; same slug grammar as project-config.schema.json).

bound_at.description: Local ISO 8601 timestamp when the binding was written (datetime.now().isoformat()).

session_id.description: Claude session UUID — identical to the hook stdin session_id and the $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID env var for this session (AMO batch 0a cross-env probe).
